Base test requires both the 31-day floor (i) and weighted 3-year day sum reaching 183 (ii); exception clause in the lead-in is handled externally per DAG rule.
ocaml:
(* substantial presence test: 31-day floor plus weighted 3-year day count *)
let meets_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_first_preceding_year : int) (days_second_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  let weighted_day_sum =
    (float_of_int days_current_year *. 1.0) +.
    (float_of_int days_first_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 3.0)) +.
    (float_of_int days_second_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 6.0))
  in
  days_current_year >= 31 &&
  weighted_day_sum >= 183.0

(* 7701(b)(3)(B): exception to substantial presence test when present < 183 days
   and closer connection to foreign country established *)
let is_closer_connection_exception
    (days_present_current_year : int)
    (sec_911_d_3 : bool) (* cross-ref: §911(d)(3), tax home in foreign country, without regard to second sentence thereof *)
    (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool)
    : bool =
  days_present_current_year < 183 &&
  sec_911_d_3 &&
  has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country
